description: Send a message to the Utilify team on behalf of a person who has agreed to send it. Requires sender_approved true. Fields are name, email, an optional phone, an optional ZIP, a topic and a message. Returns a reference id. The team replies by email. Do not include a Social Security number, date of birth, or a license number.

email.description: Email address the team should reply to.

phone.description: Optional phone number. Leave it out if the person did not offer one.

sender_approved.description: True only after the person agrees to send this message.

topic.description: question, concierge, plan_data, coverage, correction, press, partnership, or other.

name: contact_utilify
